subject: RP9 comprehensive data bug summary (6 known issues)
body:
Comprehensive list of all RP9 data bugs discovered during GP test suite generation (tests 2000-2150):

1. Q13 key_point stored as [10,8] array instead of {x:10, y:8} object (all others use object format)
2. Q14 missing 'points' field (undefined)
3. Q14 missing 'prompt' field (undefined)
4. Q15 missing 'points' field (undefined)
5. Q15 missing 'prompt' field (undefined)
6. Q13 inputs q13_domain, q13_range, q13_endbeh have no 'answer' field (undefined)
7. Q15 input q15_model has no 'answer' field (undefined)

All 7 issues are in data/retake-practice-9.json.

GP tests 2033, 2034, 2057 (prior) and 2149 (latest) document these as known exceptions.
When GI fixes the data, these exceptions should be removed.

Priority: HIGH -- RP9 is actively used by Kai and the missing answer fields mean those inputs cannot be auto-graded.
